decisions: Design 3.3 asks BIND only when 'the column has more than 4 values'. But 2.5's vector, the one 7.3 names, asks it over Household November's State column, which has 4 (plan, paid, due 2026-11-22, estimated). The vector wins: BIND is asked whenever no value matches at all. A half match never goes to the model; it is your question at once ('exact or asked').

Which values a BIND lists: the values of the columns where a value repeats (the ones that sort the rows), else every short text column. Up to 8, ranked by spelling against your words. For the vector this is State: paid, plan, due 2026-11-22, estimated.
The words of a total step that are not the sheet's own title words are words for its rows. Words that a different listed sheet's title shares more of give B3's NAMES_ANOTHER question.

A sheet with no date column is placed in time by the month its title names ('Household November' is for November, said on the card). 'in October' over it is refused plainly. A sheet with neither a date column nor a month in its title gives 'cannot tell which rows are of ...'.
A month named without a year is its latest one not after today's month, and her words say which year. 'since <Month>' runs from the 1st of that month to today.
